name: MATH
description: A dataset of 12,500 competition-level mathematics problems spanning algebra, counting, geometry, number theory, precalculus, and probability at five difficulty levels (1–5). Problems are drawn from AMC, AIME, and MATHCOUNTS competitions. The commonly used MATH-500 subset contains 500 representative problems for faster evaluation.
evaluation_method: accuracy (symbolic equivalence checking of mathematical expressions)
typical_sota_score: ~94–98% on MATH-500 (approaching saturation for top reasoning models; when released, best model scored <10%)
reputation: Standard competition-level math benchmark; introduced by Dan Hendrycks; MATH-500 subset widely adopted in model evaluation reports; featured in major leaderboards
notes: MATH-500 (the 500-problem subset) is widely used and approaching saturation for top models at ~96%+. Full MATH dataset still provides some differentiation. Requires symbolic math evaluation rather than simple string matching. Chain-of-Thought prompting significantly improves performance. Reasoning models using test-time compute achieve near-perfect scores on MATH-500.
